question: Which of the following is the main cause of land degradation in Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deforestation due to mining**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main cause of land degradation in Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh is deforestation due to mining:
 
• Mining activities in these states have caused extensive damage to the land and environment.
 
• This is because mining involves deforestation, removal of topsoil, and excavation, which results in soil erosion, loss of fertility, and land degradation.
 
• Other factors
 
 
• Other factors that contribute to land degradation in these states include overgrazing, over-irrigation, and mineral processing.
 
 
 
• Sustainable practices
 
 
• To mitigate the negative impact of mining, sustainable mining practices, reforestation, and restoration of degraded lands are crucial.
